newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends slightly firmer vs dlr in slack trade.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends slightly firmer vs dlr in slack trade.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed slightly firmer against the dollar on Monday in quiet trade, dealers said.
The Hungarian forint ended right on the national bank resistance level (bid) at 155.30/35 to the dollar, compared to its 155.40/45 opening.
"The Hungarian unit tracked a quiet dollar/mark cross on international markets," said Balazs Benczedi of West LB Hungaria.
Currency futures trade on the Budapest Commodity Exchange was light, with the yen accounting for most of the 451 million forints' turnover.
The yen rose for March June and September, the mark was mixed, while the dollar fell for December and September.
